### Technical details

Put this component into the ui-kit library.

Props:

* size, defaults to medium
* color: solid & pale, defaults to pale
* fallbackVariant: icon, initials, image, defaults to initials (if name given, otherwise use image)

    * fallbackIcon: string, defaults to essentials/user
    * fallbackImage: string, default depends on theme
    * name: string, default empty.
    * Depending on the fallbackVariant, display either the icon, image or initials. For initals, take the name, split it by whitespace and use the first letter of the first and last entry (ex. Sebastian Kurt Langer => SL).
    
* src: string, defaults to empty. URL of the image to display. If none is given, shows fallback

summary: Avatar component for displaying user images, initials, or icons with size and color variants.
features: Multiple sizes with theme-specific border radius
Pale and solid color variants with theme colors
shortDescription: The Avatar component provides flexible user representation across the UI through profile images, auto-generated initials, or icon fallbacks. It intelligently extracts initials from names by taking the first letter of the first and last words (e.g., "Sebastian Kurt Langer" becomes "SL"). Four size variants (small, medium, large, extra large) use theme-controlled border radius values, while pale and solid color variants apply distinct background, icon, and text colors. Each theme provides custom placeholder images ensuring visual consistency when no user image is available.
